stations.title: Solder paste dispense
stations.does: Dispenses solder paste onto PCB pads on the carrier-mounted board.
steps: Verify carrier arrival and correct board present with a photo-eye check.
Lower dispense nozzle to the carrier-defined standoff above the PCB pads.
Dispense solder paste pattern onto the pads (multi-passes as required by the stencil).
Retract nozzle and dwell to clear strings.
Index conveyor to send carrier to component placement.

stations.title: SCARA component placement
stations.does: Places ~20 components onto pasted pads using feeders.
steps: Confirm board on carrier (photo-eye) and pick-up datum alignment.
SCARA picks components from the parts feeders (at least two-gripper orientation handled by tool change or gripper rotation).
For each component: move to placement pose, lower to contact, release, and lift.
Perform a brief post-placement settling wait for paste compliance.
Index conveyor to the reflow oven station.

stations.title: Reflow soldering
stations.does: Runs the carrier through a reflow oven to reflow paste and solder components.
steps: Gate carrier into the reflow conveyor/zone.
Apply the oven thermal profile (preheat, soak, reflow, cool) for the timed dwell required by the process recipe.
Cool enough to avoid board shift after leaving the oven zone.
Transfer carrier out of oven to AOI inlet position.
Index conveyor to the AOI station.

stations.title: AOI optical inspection
stations.does: Automated optical inspection checks each board for soldering and placement defects.
steps: Hold carrier at the AOI scan position.
Capture required images (top and, if configured, angled views) using the vision system.
Run AOI pass/fail algorithms for pad wetting, tombstoning, missing/shifted components, and solder bridge checks.
Store inspection result associated with the board/carrier ID.
Release carrier to the routing sorter.

stations.title: Route reject or good flow
stations.does: If AOI fails, route to reject lane; otherwise continue good flow.
steps: Read AOI result tied to the carrier ID.
If FAIL: actuate a side pusher/transfer mechanism to divert the carrier to the reject lane.
If PASS: keep the carrier on the main flow path.
Ensure diverted FAIL carriers clear the main conveyor guide before index.
Index main flow carriers onward (PASS only) to off-carrier removal.

stations.title: Remove board to tote
stations.does: Removes good boards from the carrier into a tote.
steps: Confirm carrier is the PASS flow stream (reject lanes already removed).
Pick the PCB from the pallet carrier using a vacuum pad (or equivalent end-effector) with controlled descent to prevent smearing.
Lift PCB clear of carrier and move to the tote pickup zone.
Place PCB into tote position; release vacuum.
Index conveyor to return empty carriers to the start via the lower return path.

notes: Takt is 45 s/unit at 80 boards/hour; the reflow station is budgeted at 40 s to stay within takt. If your reflow recipe + cooling time requires >45 s dwell, the line throughput cannot meet 80/h without buffering or parallel oven capacity.
Routing is modeled as: FAIL carriers are diverted out of the main flow and do not proceed to ST6; PASS carriers continue linearly to ST6.
The empty-carrier return path is assumed to be physically separated and non-interfering with forward flow (lower return path).
